notes.title: The "up to date" update
notes.notes: [h3]Bringing the Prologue up to date[/h3][p]The full game has been updated a few times since its 1.0 launch, and  we are bringing all these updates to the Prologue as well! That means a lot of balance changes and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]This includes these updates, and many bug fixes not mentioned in these.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/517463774534307658?l=english"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/499441143215293428?l=english"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/507318638682833789?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixed 16:10 aspect ratio[/h3][p]The Prologue was not playable in 16:10 because the Play/Continue button was "behind" the game's title; and therefore, a run couldn't be started. This has now been addressed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Play the full version[/h3][p]Check out the complete version here which contains a lot more content and ways of playing the game![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830970/The_Last_Flame/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Last Flame (full version) Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
[h3]The Last Flame is now officially released in early access![/h3]
Grab the game while it's 10% OFF this week: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830970/The_Last_Flame/
[h3]Make thousands of different combination and builds with:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 58 Heroes
[*] 300 Items
[*] 60 Origins
[*] 125 Relics
[/list]
[h3]Unlock the full adventure:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Access to all 5 Ascension Difficulties + 1 Challenge Difficulty
[*] Access to all 3 Acts + 1 Final Boss
[*] Access to the Endless Mode which adds an Endless Act to push the limits of your builds
[*] Access to 14 Challenges to completely change how you play the game
[/list]

[b]If you like the game, please make sure to leave a review! It helps tremendously with discoverability on Steam![/b] This is really the best way that you can support a solo dev!


[h3]Early Access[/h3]
The game launches in Early Access which means that it will get constant updates for free until 1.0! 

[previewyoutube=G67Aa_nkCjE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Special Thanks[/h3]
A special thanks to all the beta testers who have been absolutely amazing! I couldn't have made such a great game without your help! From bug reports to feedback to suggestions to typo corrections to being an amazing community and friends that I could talk to about the game or just meme around about phlugee. You gave me the strength to stay extremely motivated, and give my 100% to make The Last Flame into the best possible game! Thank you, thank you so much!
